title: Input membership in its transcript set
statement: For every deterministic two-party protocol $p$ and every input pair $(x,y)\in X\times Y$, the pair $(x,y)$ belongs to the input set of the transcript produced by executing $p$ on $(x,y)$.
replaced:
Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ (Alice)
and $Y$ (Bob) with output type $\alpha$, and let $(x, y) \in X \times Y$ be an input
pair. Executing $p$ on $(x, y)$ yields a syntactic transcript, and the pair $(x, y)$
itself belongs to the input set of that transcript.
